tonight.headline: Behind by 6.8 with nobody left, and two starters hurt
body: Bad news first. Your lineup is finished at 63.7 and Team 13 lead with 70.5 and Kyle Pitts still to play tonight; ESPN gives you 1%. Saquon Barkley and Rashee Rice both left with hamstring injuries in the first quarter, for 2.0 points between them. Neither has a scan result this afternoon. Barkley's coach promises answers 'probably Wednesday', and the back behind him, Tank Bigsby, needs surgery.

It was there to be won. Team 13 started two inactive players and scored 70. Your bench held Tate's 21.5, Gordon's 18.0, Golden's 11.7 and Tuten's 11.1: 50 more points than the four slots they would have filled. No brief put those players on the bench; the projection did, and two injuries did the rest. Nothing can be changed today. Next week needs a tight end, and that is Tuesday's decision.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Allen 18.0, McCaffrey 16.0, the Seahawks D/ST 12, Worthy 11.0, Aubrey 10, Kelce 3.5, and zeros from Rachaad White and DeVonta Smith, both inactive. Pitts (7.4 projected) plays tonight and is active.

case.label: Where the 50 points were
case.body: Gordon for Barkley, 16.0. Tate for Rice, 21.5. Golden and Tuten for Wilson and Downs, 12.5. The first two are injury exits nobody could set a lineup around. The last is two coin flips by projection.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing on your side. Pitts would need to score below minus 6.8.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · when the week rolls, if Barkley is ruled out
doFirst.title: If Barkley is ruled out for London, start Tuten in his slot
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from this morning and still unarmed: no scan result, and his coach says answers come 'probably Wednesday'. Don't fire this until there is a ruling.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right hamstring on his second carry, four snaps in. No MRI result was published on Monday. Nick Sirianni: 'We'll see how everything responds and then have more answers for you probably Wednesday' (NBC Sports/PFT, 5 Oct). Rapoport on Sunday called it not 'overly serious'. Week 5 is Jacksonville in London on Sunday morning.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: Tank Bigsby, who replaced him, is having core-muscle surgery and is out about six weeks (Rapoport via NBC Sports/PFT, 5 Oct). Will Shipley is the only healthy back on the Eagles' roster. That doesn't make Barkley less likely to play; it means his team has no cover if he can't.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: 17 of Jacksonville's 23 backfield carries, 74%, with two touchdowns called back (archive; NBC Sports). His brief exit on Sunday has no follow-up, and he wasn't in his coach's Monday injury update. Gordon scored more on 11 touches and 22 snaps, half the yards on one run; Kamara plays tonight as New Orleans' lead back for the first time.

case.label: The projection has the last word
case.body: ESPN hasn't published Week 5 numbers. If it puts Gordon or Kamara two or more above Tuten, follow the projection, not this card.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Barkley practises in full by Friday and plays: it never fires. If it fires: the back you start scores less than the best back left on your bench that week (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Barkley: no result, an answer promised for Wednesday, and his backup gone
whatWentWrong.lead: Four snaps, 2.0 points. It says nothing about him as a player and everything about Week 5.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: No MRI result on Monday; Sirianni says 'probably Wednesday'. Bigsby needs core-muscle surgery and is out about six weeks; Shipley is the only healthy Eagles back, with three more on the practice squad (NBC Sports/PFT; RotoWire, 5 Oct).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The card above, and nothing else. You own three replacements, so no claim is needed: Tuten is named, and the Week 5 projection can overrule that in favour of Gordon or Kamara. Shipley is the handcuff the screen now ranks first; he is a watch, because you would be spending a seat to back up a slot you can already fill.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice from Barkley by Friday, or a ruling on Wednesday that he is out for more than London.

whatWentWrong.sources: NBC Sports/PFT · RotoWire · Inquirer · Week 4 archive

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end slot is empty in Week 5, and one of the three candidates firmed up
whatWentWrong.lead: Waller and Rice are both off next week. Receiver is covered from your bench; tight end isn't.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Kansas City and Carolina are the only Week 5 byes (CBS schedule; Yahoo, 5 Oct). Caleb Williams is out for Week 5 and Bagent starts, which was Loveland's condition: he drew 9 targets from Bagent on Sunday (archive). Jefferson has no update, which leaves Hockenson undecided. Lamar Jackson has no scan result; his coach doesn't think it is 'crazy long-term' and Tyler Huntley is next, which leaves Andrews undecided.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Receiver: Wilson, Downs, Tate and Golden fill two slots and the flex. Tight end: all three candidates are on waivers until Wed 01:00, and a claim would drop you from 8th to last in an order that never resets. A one-week fill-in isn't what that priority is for; a free add after they clear is. This connects to the card above only through the seat: if Barkley is out too, every bench back is needed.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuesday's news on Jefferson and Jackson. Tomorrow's brief picks the tight end and names the seat.

case.body: Emanuel Wilson: 21 carries, 4 targets, 27.0. Holani: 7 carries, 1 target, 3.0 (archive). Yahoo lists him only as a 'risky flex'. Charbonnet won't play in Week 5 but takes team reps (Macdonald, 5 Oct), and Seattle worked out Joe Mixon on Monday. KEI returns already hold Charbonnet.

case.body: Wilson getting hurt before Charbonnet is activated.

cannotSee.body: A tight end needs a seat. Wilson, Downs, Kamara and Gordon each have an injured teammate and can't be named. Waller is the like-for-like seat, added on 3 Oct, and his open thesis hasn't tripped; a bye isn't a ruling-out. Tuesday's brief has to settle that. I haven't.
